title: Tobermory Village Campground & Cabins

services.name: Glamping Pod
services.desc: The term "glamping" comes from "glamorous camping" and it means that you don't have to set up a tent! You are swapping the tedious process of setting up your tent for a cozy and "ready-to-go" glamping pod. They are conveniently located at the Village Pond, very close to bathrooms, showers, and a dishwashing station. The pods are lockable and have one queen-sized bed with a mattress. Guests bring their own bedding. They do not have electricity. There is a picnic table and fire pit at each glamping pod. For glamping pod availability, please click here.
